$comment: ILLUSTRATIVE SYNTHETIC DATA ONLY. All identities, UPNs, package ids, GUIDs, and organisation names are fictional (Contoso / Northwind). This dataset does NOT represent a real tenant, real agents, or real licensing state. It is a sample BI-ready combined output produced by the integrated discovery scanner (discover_agents.py --agent365 present --registry-export ... --resolve-entitlement). The combined output reflects the exact shape returned by scan_all: top-level keys are summary, agents, features, and authShares. The summary block carries runId, counts (argAgentCount, scannedAgentCount, coreAgentCount, featureCount, authShareCount, environmentCount), reconciliation, and — when the respective flags are active — packageNewRowCount, packageScanTruncated, registryCorrelation, and entitlementResolution sub-objects. The summary ALSO carries the agent365 resolution block (requestedMode, resolvedState, resolutionSource, detectionConfidence, licenseProbeAttempted, packageApiAttempted, layerStatus, httpStatus, sanitized errorCode/errorSubcode/reason, packagesObserved, packageNewRowCount, pagingTruncated) and the coverageScope block (layers.arg/environmentDataverse/packageApi/registry/entitlement statuses nested under coverageScope.layers, plus authoritativeFor, limitations, warning). runId is a synthetic collision-resistant, sortable identifier (UTC timestamp prefix + random suffix, <=36 chars), used identically in summary.runId and every agent fsi_runid so agent rows join to the fsi_caiscanrun ledger row. packageNewRowCount and packageScanTruncated remain DEPRECATED top-level mirrors, retained in this sample because it represents an attempted (present) Package API run; when the Package API is not attempted they are omitted and agent365.packagesObserved/packageNewRowCount are null (not observed) rather than 0 (observed empty). The enum label strings for detectionConfidence and resolutionSource reflect the integrated scanner/schema contract: detectionConfidence carries one of OperatorDeclared/Confirmed/Heuristic/Inconclusive/NotApplicable, and resolutionSource is a plain String (one of CLI/Environment/DeprecatedAlias/Default/LicenseProbe/DryRun) that the flow writes directly to fsi_agent365resolutionsource with NO label-to-integer conversion. This file is the SCANNER JSON ONLY — there is deliberately no top-level scanRun key; the Dataverse fsi_caiscanrun run-row mapping is shown separately in docs/flow-configuration.md. Field names are Dataverse LOGICAL names (SchemaName lowercased, no underscores between words). Picklist fields carry LABEL strings; the Power Automate flow converts each label to its option-set integer via Switch/Compose before the upsert (Update a row with an alternate key); the scanner itself performs no Dataverse write and no label-to-integer conversion. Package ids use the P_... id space from the Microsoft Graph Package Management API and are DISTINCT from Copilot Studio bot GUIDs. fsi_ownerentitlementevidence contains matched service-plan GUIDs ONLY (NOT SKU GUIDs). Upsert routing: enriched rows (Rows 1, 2, 3, 5; fsi_discoverysource == 'Reconciled (multi-source)') carry BOTH fsi_agentid and fsi_environmentid and route to fsi_AgentEnvKey (Branch A — checked first); package-only row (Row 4; fsi_discoverysource == 'Package Management API', fsi_agentid == fsi_packageid) has no fsi_environmentid and routes to fsi_PackageKey (Branch B). Row notes: Row 1 (Loan Origination Assistant, Contoso) — Reconciled (multi-source), Paid Copilot, Exact owner from Agent Registry Export; evidence: M365_COPILOT_BUSINESS_CHAT service-plan GUID 3f30311c-6b1e-48a4-ab79-725b469da960. Row 2 (Account Summary Bot, Northwind) — Reconciled (multi-source), Copilot Chat Only, Exact owner from Agent Registry Export; evidence: Bing_Chat_Enterprise deny-plan GUID 0d0c0d31-fae7-41f2-b909-eaf4d7f26dba. Row 3 (Regulatory Filing Assistant, Contoso) — Reconciled (multi-source), Unknown entitlement (pwsh subprocess failed at resolution time), Heuristic owner (UPN-only match, no object GUID returned; export is stale >45 days at scan time). Row 4 (Trade Confirmation Helper, Contoso) — Package Management API (package-only: no bot-GUID row matched appId or manifestId; fsi_agentid = fsi_packageid), Unresolved owner, Unknown entitlement. Row 5 (Portfolio Risk Advisor, Contoso) — Reconciled (multi-source), Paid Copilot, Exact owner from Dataverse Owner field (live, no staleness signal); evidence: M365_COPILOT_APPS service-plan GUID a62f8878-de10-42f3-b68f-6149a25ceb97. The default registry alias map includes the validated July 2026 native headers Name, Bot Id, Owner, and Date created. Creator Id is distinct from Owner and is intentionally not mapped to owner_id.
